sn9.12:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam aññataro bhikkhu Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā yena so bhikkhu ten-upasaṅkami || || Upasaṅkamitvā tassa bhikkhuno santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn9.12:2.1: Ṭhite majjhantike kāle || sannisinnesu pakkhisu || saṇateva mahāraññaṃ || taṃ bhayaṃ paṭibhāti maṃ || ||
sn9.12:3.1: Ṭhite majjhantike kāle || sannisinnesu pakkhisu || saṇateva mahāraññaṃ || sā rati patibhāti man ti || ||
